## 📡 CORS Network Daily Uptime & Vendor Escalations

Geodetic & Research Branch (GRB), Dehradun monitors all pan-India CORS network stations. Stations falling below **95% uptime threshold** are escalated daily to vendor **Leica Geosystems / Hexagon** (`bhuvan.joshi@hexagon.com`).
